reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getAverageFillCategories (which applies the shared shouldFillCategory rule) and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, and reuses getSheetValue, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable registration.

duplication.why: No selection or sign logic is restated; the new action is only the per-category amount lookup.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration, a test and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Straightforward and consistent with its siblings; the only wrinkle is reusing a helper named for averages (averageToBudgetAmount, getAverageFillCategories) for a non-average action.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getAverageFillCategories/shouldFillCategory like the other month-wide actions.
